---
title: "01 — Data ingestion"
format: html
## Load required packages
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(here)
library(janitor)

## Confirm that source files are available
required_files <- c("adsl.xpt", "adae.xpt", "adqsadas.xpt")
raw_paths <- here("data", "raw", required_files)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(raw_paths)]
if (length(missing_files)) stop("Add to data/raw/: ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))

## Import and standardise the datasets
read_adam <- function(filename) read_xpt(here("data", "raw", filename)) |> clean_names()
adsl <- read_adam("adsl.xpt")
adae <- read_adam("adae.xpt")
adqsadas <- read_adam("adqsadas.xpt")
```

## Structure checks
## Validate dataset dimensions and identifiers
```{r}
tibble(dataset = c("ADSL", "ADAE", "ADQSADAS"),
       rows = c(nrow(adsl), nrow(adae), nrow(adqsadas)),
       columns = c(ncol(adsl), ncol(adae), ncol(adqsadas)))

stopifnot("usubjid" %in% names(adsl), !anyDuplicated(adsl$usubjid))
list(ADSL = names(adsl), ADAE = names(adae), ADQSADAS = names(adqsadas))
```

## Missingness and treatment review
## Review missing values
```{r}
adsl |> summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |> pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  arrange(desc(value)) |> slice_head(n = 20)

## Review treatment assignments
treatment_var <- intersect(c("trt01p", "trt01a"), names(adsl))[1]
if (is.na(treatment_var)) stop("Confirm the treatment variable in docs/data_dictionary.md")
adsl |> count(.data[[treatment_var]])
```

## Save clean copies

```{r}
dir.create(here("data", "processed"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(adsl, here("data", "processed", "adsl_clean.csv"))
write_csv(adae, here("data", "processed", "adae_clean.csv"))
write_csv(adqsadas, here("data", "processed", "adqsadas_clean.csv"))
```
